queries: Gary Marcus "neurosymbolic AI will displace pure LLMs"

sources_considered.why: A 2025 survey preprint. It frames symbolic methods as something to integrate into LLMs, not as a replacement. Useful context on where the field stands.
An opinion and trade piece arguing for a shift. It is advocacy, not adoption evidence.
An aggregator summary of Marcus's own posts. The speaker's own writing cannot count as evidence.
A workshop announcement. It frames the topic but shows no adoption.
An interview with the speaker. These are his own views.

receipt.public_excerpt: there is a limited systematic understanding of how symbolic AI can be effectively integrated into LLMs.

evidence_items.explanation: This survey treats neurosymbolic methods as something to merge into LLMs and calls the field's understanding limited. That fits an early research stage, not displacement. It is context only and does not settle an open-horizon forecast.

unresolved_gaps: I found no primary-source evidence, as of 2026-10-28, that neurosymbolic systems have replaced pure LLMs as the main approach at leading labs or in leading products.
Whether LLMs with tools or agent harnesses count as 'neurosymbolic' is disputed, and the claim does not define it.
The forecast has no deadline, so the absence of displacement so far does not refute it.
